title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could modify a…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks can modify a child playbook callback handle associated with another playbook run. This occurs because the Playbook API does not verify that callback-handle updates belong to the related parent and child playbook runs, potentially altering the callback behavior of that run.
